title: Tricuspid edge-to-edge repair
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: Generic edge-to-edge clip
designs.summary: A generic clip grasps a pair of leaflets in a representative three-leaflet valve.

states.label: 1. Clip arms open
states.note: The clip is below the anterior–septal seam before the representative grasp.

states.label: 2. Clip grasped, valve closed
states.note: The device stays closed while the leaflets are in a representative closed pose.

states.label: 3. Clip grasped, valve open
states.note: The same device remains locked; the remaining leaflet area opens around the grasp.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: Right chambers
views.title: See the valve between the chambers
views.lesson: The right atrium and right ventricle of a real heart are opened along their long axis. The clip holds two leaflet edges together while the rest of the valve opens and closes around it.

views.label: Local approach
views.title: Approach from the right atrium
views.lesson: This venous example approaches the tricuspid target from the right atrium. The arrow is schematic.

views.label: Mechanism section
views.title: See the fixed leaflet grasp
views.lesson: The near leaflet surface is sectioned to expose tissue between the opposing clip arms and grippers. The grasp stays fixed as the remaining leaflet area opens.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: Understand depth and attachment
views.lesson: An oblique view separates the near surface, device and supporting tissue.

views.label: Face view
views.title: Look along the opening
views.lesson: The face view complements the section. All poses and proportions are representative, not measured.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

junction.label: TRICUSPID VALVE
junction.body: The tricuspid valve lies between the right atrium and right ventricle. Its depicted shape is schematic.

leaflets.label: VALVE LEAFLETS
leaflets.body: These representative surfaces illustrate leaflet relationships. The positions shown are representative; they are not measured or computed.

ventricular_support.label: PAPILLARY MUSCLES
ventricular_support.body: Papillary muscles arise from the ventricular wall and support the valve leaflets through chordae. Their shapes are schematic.

device.label: GENERIC REPAIR DEVICE
device.body: The highlighted device and attachment shapes are representative of this class, not a specific product or a prediction.

region_atrium.label: RIGHT ATRIUM
region_atrium.body: The right atrium sits above the valve. Its shape comes from a real heart, opened along its long axis.

region_ventricle.label: RIGHT VENTRICLE
region_ventricle.body: The right ventricle sits below the valve. Its cavity and wall shape come from the same real heart.

region_valve.label: TRICUSPID VALVE
region_valve.body: Three leaflets hang from the ring where the atrium joins the ventricle. Leaflet shape is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

region_support.label: PAPILLARY MUSCLES
region_support.body: Two papillary muscles rise from the ventricular wall. Cords fan out from their tips to the leaflet edges. Their shapes are representative.

region_device.label: GENERIC EDGE-TO-EDGE CLIP
region_device.body: The clip holds two leaflet edges together. Its shape and position are representative, not a specific product.

region_access.label: ATRIAL APPROACH
region_access.body: A venous example approaches the tricuspid valve from the right atrium.
